title: Lentils with Cauliflower, Carrots, Caper-Parsley Salsa Verde & Feta

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Add to the baking sheet with the cauliflower.

Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheet along with whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
While the lentils are cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Mince capers. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with additional oil, vinegar, and pepper; set aside.
When the lentils are done, drain and return to the pan. Cover and set aside.

When the veggies are done, carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins. Mash with a fork, add to the bowl with the parsley mixture, and stir to combine the salsa verde.
Add half of the salsa verde to the pan with the lentils. Stir to combine. (Reserve remaining salsa verde for serving.)
To serve, divide lentils between plates or bowls; top with the veggies, feta, and reserved salsa verde. Enjoy!
